texts.title: Text A: Harbour View Youth Hostel, Guest Information

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
RECEPTION: Open daily from 7.00 am to 10.00 pm. If you expect to arrive after 10.00 pm, please telephone us in advance so that we can arrange a late check-in.

CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT: Rooms are available from 2.00 pm. Please check out by 10.00 am. You may leave your luggage at reception on the day of departure free of charge.

PRICES (per night): Dormitory bed £22. Private double room £55. Breakfast is not included in these prices and costs an additional £6 per person.

KITCHEN: A fully equipped kitchen is available for guests free of charge, from 7.00 am to 10.00 pm. Please wash up after use and label any food you keep in the fridge.

SECURITY: Each bed has a locker. Guests must bring their own padlock; if you forget, you can buy one at reception for £4.

QUIET TIME: To allow everyone to sleep, noise in the dormitories is not permitted after 11.00 pm. Alcohol may not be consumed in bedrooms.

INTERNET: Wireless internet is free in the common room, but it is not available in the bedrooms. Laundry facilities are in the basement; a wash costs £3.

texts.title: Text B: Getting Around by Bus

paragraphs.label: B
paragraphs.text:
ROUTE 12 runs between the railway station, the hostel and the city centre every 20 minutes, from 7.00 am to 7.00 pm. After 7.00 pm, buses run every hour. On Friday and Saturday evenings, the last bus leaves the city centre at 11.30 pm. There is no service on public holidays.

TICKETS: A single journey costs £2.20. A day ticket, which allows unlimited travel, costs £5.00. Children under five travel free. Students receive a 30 per cent discount on all tickets if they show a valid student card.

PAYMENT: Tickets are bought from the driver, who can accept only cash. Please have the exact money ready, as drivers cannot give change. The Harbour Bay app can be used to buy tickets for later use, and these can be paid for by card.

LOST PROPERTY: Items left on buses are taken to the bus station on Market Street and are kept for 14 days.

texts.title: Text C: Things to Do in Harbour Bay

paragraphs.label: C
paragraphs.text:
OLD TOWN WALKING TOUR: Every day at 10.00 am. The tour lasts two hours and costs £10 per person. It begins at the clock tower in the main square. Guests who book through the reception desk at their accommodation receive a 10 per cent discount.

HARBOUR MUSEUM: Open Tuesday to Sunday, 10.00 am to 5.00 pm. Normal entry costs £6, but entry is free on the first Sunday of every month. The museum has a café with views across the bay.

CASTLE: The castle is open from 9.30 am to 5.30 pm every day except Monday, when it is closed for maintenance. Audio guides in six languages are available for £3.

BOAT TRIPS: Trips around the bay run between April and October. They leave from the harbour every hour and last 45 minutes. The cost is £14 for adults and £8 for children.

BICYCLE HIRE: Bicycles can be hired from Bay Cycles on Quay Street for £12 per day. A helmet and lock are included. Customers must show photo identification.
